about_the_game: Scarlet Moon and independent game developer Sinclair Strange are pleased to present Sir Noggin, a charming Master System-inspired 2D platformer full of challenging combat and adventure. Featuring the big-brained Sir Noggin and his big sword, players will slice their way through six stages, using several abilities at their disposal, and challenge epic bosses, all while jamming out to a catchy chiptune score by Scarlet Moon composer coda (Consume Me, VIDEOBALL, Read Only Memories: Neurodiver).
